executive_summary.conclusion: Arngren is crawlable and its inspected pages expose product, contact, warranty and payment facts, but the homepage and product flow are difficult to interpret because of mixed inventory, encoding defects and materially inconsistent/stale price cues. A rendered browser pass completed two public journeys and confirmed that purchase information is reachable, while AI visibility itself was not measured.

not_checked: Actual assistant answers/citations, provider IP access, Search Console settings and behavioral analytics were not measured.
Keyboard focus, mobile breakpoints and overlays were not separately tested.
Only a bounded five-page static sample plus rendered landing, product, recycling/contact and payment destinations was inspected; site-wide absence claims are not supported.
Off-site corroboration used search results for entity identity; no official registry page was opened directly.

readiness.detail: HTTPS homepage and sampled HTTP pages returned 200; robots policy permitted named search, training and user-fetch agents. This is policy evidence, not proof of provider crawling.
Static and rendered text exposed product descriptions, prices, contact details, warnings, warranty and payment instructions. Repeated mojibake and fragmented link labels reduce clean extraction.
Three representative questions were tested against relevant pages; offer and constraints are answerable, while current price/order-state interpretation remains partial because of conflicting cues.

An external exact-entity search result independently matched the legal name, organisation number, Oslo address, phone and website. Product performance and historic marketing claims were not independently corroborated.

Rendered browser inspection traced a product-to-payment-information route and a recycling/contact route; both reached public destinations without submission. The purchase path is manual bank transfer/Vipps plus email, not a cart checkout.

journeys.task: Understand a featured product and reach purchase instructions

steps.action: Open rendered homepage and select the 139,- alkotester link
steps.observation: Homepage exposes the product and a 139,- link among a very large mixed inventory.

steps.action: Read product details and select the rendered Kjøp/139,- handoff
steps.observation: Product page provides range, calibration, battery, safety and warranty details; Kjøp links point to kjop.html.

steps.action: Open public payment instructions; stop before any submission
steps.observation: Destination explains bank transfer/Vipps, 199,- shipping, 2-5 day delivery, email order details and returns. No form submission was made.

journeys.reason: The public endpoint is reached, but the product page contains conflicting 399,- and 139,- prices and the handoff requires a manual payment/email workflow.

journeys.task: Verify recycling eligibility and contact details

steps.observation: A link leads to el-varer.html, but labels are fragmented across the legacy layout.

steps.action: Read recycling scope and contact block
steps.observation: Page says it accepts corresponding small electronics/model-hobby products for free, gives Sondreveien 3K Oslo, phone and email, and links Oslo waste guidance.

journeys.reason: The public eligibility and contact destination was rendered and its answer was visible; no submission or external side effect occurred.

visibility.detail: No recorded assistant answer runs or citation observations; crawl, browser and search evidence are separate from citation-rate measurement.

findings.title: Conflicting product prices leave the payable amount unresolved

evidence.observation: The rendered alkotester page states 'Best.nr. 1020 kr. 399,-' but also shows a 'Tilbud ! 139,-' purchase link; the linked payment page gives process and shipping but does not resolve which price is current.

suggested_action.summary: Publish one canonical current price and label any sale/wholesale price with validity and variant qualifiers on the product and payment pages.
suggested_action.mechanism: A single machine-readable and visible price reduces ambiguity for visitors and retrieval systems when answering cost questions.
suggested_action.verification: For the alkotester, product page, purchase handoff and any structured data show the same current NOK price, with sale and wholesale conditions explicitly separated.

findings.title: Legacy homepage structure and encoding fragments interpretation

evidence.observation: Rendered homepage presents hundreds of mixed categories and fragmented link labels, including mojibake such as 'Kj ø p' and a visible '(Fra 07.11.2004)' date; the same pattern appears in sampled pages.

suggested_action.summary: Refactor the landing page into grouped category and product cards, fix UTF-8 encoding, and add clear updated timestamps and descriptive link names.
suggested_action.mechanism: Semantic grouping and clean labels make product identity, qualifiers and destinations easier for readers and extractors to associate.
suggested_action.verification: Rendered and source views show valid Norwegian characters, unique descriptive anchors, grouped categories and a current updated date on the landing page.

findings.title: Purchase handoff relies on manual payment and email with limited context continuity

evidence.observation: The alkotester purchase link reaches a static page instructing visitors to transfer to bank account [public bank account redacted] or Vipps [public payment phone redacted], then email address, phone, order numbers and paid amount; no cart or product-specific order context is carried into the destination.

suggested_action.summary: Add a product-specific order handoff (cart or prefilled, non-sensitive order summary) and clearly separate payment, shipping and returns before any payment step.
suggested_action.mechanism: Preserving product, quantity and current price context reduces manual transcription and makes the next step unambiguous without requiring a visitor to submit sensitive data on-site.
suggested_action.verification: Selecting Kjøp from a product opens a destination that visibly carries product name, SKU, quantity and current price, plus shipping/returns, before any payment or email action.

proactive_opportunities.title: Add concise product metadata and FAQ blocks
proactive_opportunities.rationale: The inspected product page already contains useful range, dimensions, battery, calibration, warranty and safety facts that could be presented in a consistent answer-ready format.
proactive_opportunities.mechanism: Stable labeled fields and FAQs improve extraction and visitor scanning without relying on a special AI schema.
proactive_opportunities.verification: For three representative products, visible labeled fields cover price, variant, constraints, warranty and next step and match source values.
